name: final-spec

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: short, medium, long, xlong, 70k: solo drafted == serial (ids and finish reason)
short, medium, long, xlong at once: drafted == their solo serial replies
the drafted replies drafted tokens (the drafter ran)

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (gate spec: bench/tools/gates.py spec; serial = "draft": false, drafted = the booted dspark)
notes: Boot g, shipping defaults (SPEC=dspark). gates.py spec: serial reference replies ("draft": false, prefix cache off) against the drafted replies, five prompts up to 73,154 tokens solo and four of them at once; 128 greedy tokens each.
